question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part.

The __crux__ of the study has been delineated by the researcher.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"crux" **means the** central theme or point.**

 
 
• **Example: T**he** crux **of the matter is that attitudes have changed.
 
 
 
• **"Central point"** refers to the most important or main point of something. (मुख्य बिंदु)
 
 
• **Example: **The** central point** of the meeting was to discuss the new project timeline.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct replacement for** 'crux' **in the context of the sentence is **'central point'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Collected data** (संग्रहित डेटा): Information that has been gathered for analysis.

 
 
• **Example:** The researcher analyzed the collected data to draw conclusions.
 
 
 
• **Relevant part** (संबंधित हिस्सा): A section that is pertinent or applicable.
 
 
• **Example:** Please focus on the relevant part of the report for your presentation.
 
 
 
• **Fixed limitation** (निर्धारित सीमा): A set boundary or restriction.
 
 
• **Example:** The experiment was conducted within a fixed limitation of time and resources.
